thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT | tenant-check:norwell-heartbeat flapping — 23% error rate, p95 latency 1.9s (> SLA 1.0s) in last 8m. Paging oncall. https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/2140009876

maria: I'm on it. seeing the same in dashboard. likely noisy checks — threshold is a hard 1s for all tenants. that sucks.

aj: paging is noisy; per-tenant baseline would help. short-term: can we debounce the pager and route to SRE instead of paging infra?

kelly: agree. can we flip the alert to severity=warning for tenant tag 'norwell' so it doesn't page, while we run an adaptive threshold experiment?

ben: I can push an emergency rule tweak. recommend: increase threshold to 2.5s for that tenant, add 10m debounce, and enable heatmap-based baselining for 6h rollup.

sahil: +1. also want to capture an evaluation set for regressions — add `check=norwell` to the alert details.

maria: doing the tweak now. CLI command below, will post audit link.

```bash
redwood alert update --id 8123 \
  --filter "tenant:norwell" \
  --threshold 2.5 --debounce 600 --severity warning
```

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook 'tenant-alert-debounce' triggered by maria. Steps: 1) adjust threshold 2) create dashboard heatmap 3) tag for experiment. Link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/tenant-alert-debounce

maria: updated rule, change pushed (audit: https://console.redwood.ai/audit/2140009901). Alert now warning and debounce 10m. tag=adaptive-experiment/norwell

aj: can someone make an adhoc dashboard heatmap (latency vs hour vs endpoint) so we can see oscillation? don't want to blindside customers.

kelly: I'll spin up a heatmap and also add a per-tenant error-rate timeseries to the incident view.

ben: adding a temporary routing policy: when severity=warning and tenant=norwell -> route to #eng-oncall (no page) and to #eng-sre for visibility. config:

```yaml
routing:
  - match: tenant:norwell severity:warning
    destinations: ["eng-oncall", "eng-sre"]
    page: false
```

sahil: important to note: this is customer-impacting if sustained. let's add a synthetic sentinel that alerts if aggregated SLA breach >5m despite debounce.

maria: good call. adding sentinel now. also capturing sample traces for the last 20 mins. link to traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/abc123

aj: can we run a short A/B: current static threshold vs heatmap adaptive for 2 hours, only for norwell, and collect alert counts and false positives? make sure to log decisions.

kelly: scheduling experiment window 20:30-22:30 UTC. will tag alerts with `experiment=adaptive-v1`.

ben: FYI I reduced SIEM paging config so security isn't flooded by warning-level noise.

sahil: I'll take watch for next 30m then handoff to @ben for overnight. if the sentinel trips, escalate to product and account team.

ben: taking handoff at 22:00 UTC. will monitor heatmap and revert thresholds if SLA impact ramps.

maria: quick summary: tweaked norwell threshold -> 2.5s + 10m debounce, set to warning, routing to eng-oncall and eng-sre, scheduled adaptive heatmap experiment 20:30-22:30 UTC, added sentinel alert for sustained SLA breaches, audit link and runbook linked. Handoff to ben at 22:00. create ticket INC-34218 and link in thread.

ops-runbook-bot: ticket INC-34218 created: https://issues.redwood.ai/INC-34218

ben: :thumbsup: will post final status and any rollback notes. if anything changes ping me and I'll wake up. otherwise will file follow-up with eval metrics.
